# Volts & VINs (https://voltsandvins.com)

> Volts & VINs is a public used-Tesla marketplace and VIN-level price benchmark index covering 15,098 active used Tesla listings across the United States (1,154 priced $500+ below mileage-adjusted peer asking benchmarks).

## Key Marketplace Facts
- **Published VIN-Decoded Catalog**: 15,098 used Tesla vehicles (Model Y, Model 3, Model S, Model X, Cybertruck)
- **Peer-Benchmarked Price Finds**: 1,154 listings priced `$500+` below mileage-adjusted peer asking prices (minimum 5 comparable peers in the same model, year, trim, drivetrain, and mileage band)
- **VIN-Decoded Specifications**: Every listing includes 17-character ISO 3779 VIN validation, VIN-derived build factory (Austin vs. Fremont), drivetrain (AWD vs. RWD), mileage, and location
- **Purchase & Reservation Model**: Online deal builder with ZIP delivery distance estimation; `$250` refundable reservation deposit after licensed selling dealer confirmation and written hold (`dealer_fulfillment`)

## Machine-Readable Feeds & Indexes
- Fast AI Agent Filter & Search API (<15ms JSON): https://api.voltsandvins.com/api/search?model=Model+Y&max_price=36000&only_price_finds=true&limit=10
- OpenAPI 3.1 Action Specification (ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini Tools): https://voltsandvins.com/openapi.json
- Full Top-100 Price-Find VIN Digest: https://voltsandvins.com/llms-full.txt
- XML Sitemap (197 URLs): https://voltsandvins.com/sitemap.xml
- Live Public JSON Catalog: https://voltsandvins.com/inventory.json
